name: remakes
note: The models the owner sent back from the US golf status page's Models to check (9 November 2026): the last hand-built trees (the Redwood Coast's California bay laurel and Pacific madrone, Hawaiian Resort's plumeria) and the hand-built plants that did not look right (ocotillo, brittlebush, sagebrush, creosote, cholla, muhly grass, bougainvillea) and the round boulder whose flat moss patches looked stuck on. Each is named Mx (a remake) because the hand-built models hold the plain names. Forms from what each plant is in life (RESEARCH, *The remakes*); sizes PLACED inside the species' own. The plants are kept light in triangles because they are planted in their thousands (creosote 7,729 on one Desert Resort course). No wind-swept shapes, no strong S in a trunk, no foliage as sausages or cones, no broken tops (the owner's rules).
style: Stylised cartoon game art in soft, flat painted colour. Simple clean shapes with a gentle gradient: darker near the trunk and underneath, lighter toward the tips and the top. Matte, muted natural palette. No photographic detail, no photo bark, no noise, no speckle, no hard shadows, no highlights, no shine, no ink outlines, no text.
view: One view only, seen from the side at eye level, the whole plant in frame from foot to tip with a margin around it, centred, on a plain white background, in even soft light, with no cast shadow.

models.name: Blender_MxBayLaurel_1
models.colour: Foliage deep olive green #4f7036. Bark grey-brown #6c6a58.
models.prompt: A California bay laurel growing under coast redwoods, 16 m tall and 12 m wide. Two or three grey-brown trunks rising together from the ground, gently leaning apart, clearly visible, without any strong S-curve. Rising limbs end in large soft rounded tufts of dense foliage, like fluffy clouds, with a lightly tufted scalloped edge. The tufts make a dense rounded dome crown with a bumpy outline, a little gap here and there showing a limb. Paint the foliage as thick, solid three-dimensional forms, never as separate leaves: no visible leaves, no leaf shapes, no lobes, no fine detail, no thin lines, no thin wisps, nothing thinner than a limb. No long hanging shapes, no sausages, no cones. No solid core, no perfect spheres, no round lollipop shape, no flat discs, no even tiers of branches. The tree stands upright and even, perfectly still on a calm day, nothing swept to one side. Only a small flare in the very bottom of the trunks, no wide base. Whole healthy tree, no broken or snapped top. Stylised cartoon game asset, matte hand-painted colour. Single tree alone, no ground, no base, no text.
